name: AI models
tagline: The model APIs your app calls, answered without a model: rules shape the reply, failures come on cue, spend is counted.

capabilities.title: Six APIs, your SDK
capabilities.text: Change only the SDK's base URL. Any key is accepted and never sent anywhere.

capabilities.title: Rules shape answers
capabilities.text: First match wins on provider, API, model prefix, the last user message, the system prompt or a tool offered.

capabilities.title: Tool calls on cue
capabilities.text: The model calls your tool first with the arguments you set, then answers the text once the result comes back.

capabilities.title: JSON and long answers
capabilities.text: Answer a JSON object, pad to about N tokens, or stop by length as max_tokens would.

capabilities.title: Streamed or not
capabilities.text: Each provider's own response and error shapes, streamed or in one piece.

capabilities.title: Every call kept
capabilities.text: Prompt, answer, model, tokens in and out, cached tokens, cost and why it got that answer.

capabilities.title: Spend you can read
capabilities.text: ai_spend per provider; prices per million tokens are editable with set_ai_price.

capabilities.title: Stable embeddings
capabilities.text: Embeddings are deterministic: the same text always gives the same vector.

callouts.title: Six providers
callouts.text: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and DeepSeek, each with its calls.

callouts.title: Point the SDK here
callouts.text: Any key is accepted; it is never sent anywhere.

callouts.title: Why this answer
callouts.text: The rule that matched, the default answer, or a failure someone forced.

callouts.title: The prompt
callouts.text: System, user and the tools the app offered, as the app sent them.

callouts.title: Tokens and cost
callouts.text: Tokens in and out, cached tokens and the cost from your prices.

callouts.title: A rule with a tool call
callouts.text: When the message contains refund: call lookup_order, then answer the text.

callouts.title: JSON on a system prompt
callouts.text: A system prompt that asks to classify gets a JSON object.

callouts.title: Add a rule
callouts.text: Name, condition, answer text, and an optional tool with its arguments.

callouts.title: Failures on the next calls
callouts.text: 429 with Retry-After, 500, 529, filter, length, bad_json, slow and cut.

callouts.title: How many
callouts.text: Bound the failure to the next N calls; kind=none clears it.

provoke.name: Rate limit
provoke.what: 429 with Retry-After, in the provider's error shape

provoke.name: Content filtered
provoke.what: The answer is blocked by the content filter

provoke.name: Cut by max_tokens
provoke.what: The answer stops with a length finish reason

provoke.name: Broken tool arguments
provoke.what: A tool call whose JSON arguments do not parse

advantages.title: No tokens billed
advantages.text: Test suites and agents call the models all day; the spend counter counts, nobody pays.

advantages.title: Deterministic answers
advantages.text: The same prompt gets the same reply, so tests that depend on a model stop flaking.

advantages.title: Failures on demand
advantages.text: A 529, a filtered answer or a cut stream on the next call, not when the provider has a bad day.

advantages.title: Prompts you can inspect
advantages.text: Every prompt the app sent, with the tools it offered and the tokens it cost.

agent.prompt: Make our support bot retry when Anthropic is overloaded and still call lookup_order for refunds.
steps: 529 once, then 200: rule refund, tool call lookup_order
